items.title: Free Moroccan Star Diamond Lattice DXF Panel for CNC
items.description: A radiating Moroccan star medallion fills the panel's core, framed by nested star-and-cross borders and an outer diamond lattice edge. The layered border system around the central star gives this design exceptional depth, making it one of the more elaborate patterns in the collection.
